description:
Problem. docs/internal/throughput-result-alignment.md states that a stream's window starts after its connection is open and ends before it is closed. The refresh stream does not follow that rule: in the TPC-H throughput refresh stream (benchbox/core/tpch/throughput_test.py, the method that sets refresh_stream.start_monotonic), start_monotonic and start_time are set before refresh_connection_factory() is called, so connection setup is inside the refresh stream window. Query streams take their start after the connection opens.

Change. Take the refresh stream's start after the connection is open; keep end_monotonic before the connection closes. The refresh stream's start and end are part of the Ts span (benchbox/core/throughput/runner.py compute_metrics reads refresh_stream.start_monotonic and end_monotonic), so this change can shorten Ts and raise Throughput@Size when the refresh stream is the first or last stream; the changelog must say so.

Guardrails for all code work: work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create); never edit the primary clone. No explanatory comments or docstrings in source (make comment-policy-check). Durations use benchbox.utils.clock.mono_time()/elapsed_seconds(). Add a changelog.d/ fragment. Cited line numbers are orientation only: re-read the named symbols, docs and spec clauses before editing and treat a mismatch as a reason to stop and update this item. No live-cloud runs without owner approval; heavy runs only through make heavy-run or a lock-taking entry point. Green focused tests are not release certification. Do not change what the RF1 and RF2 intervals themselves measure; that belongs to tpch-refresh-checks-timing-per-decision-20261103 and perf-tpch-rf1-bulk-load-20261031. Test names must say what they assert: rename any refresh-timing test whose name claims checks or connection setup are inside the measurement when the assertions say otherwise (tests/unit/core/throughput/test_tpch_refresh_timing.py and test_throughput_runs_all_safety_checks_outside_the_refresh_measurement in tests/unit/core/tpch/test_tpch_refresh.py are the places to read).
